readings.moment: When the temple struck nine, the master had everyone show their watches.
The hall clock downstairs struck ten while Ruedi was working in the atelier.
At the moment the hall clock downstairs struck ten, the regulator showed twelve minutes to ten.
When the temple struck ten, the regulator agreed with the bell exactly.
When the master sent Ruedi downstairs.
When the piano began to play (Madame), Ruedi looked at the kitchen clock.
When the piano stopped, Ruedi looked again at the kitchen clock.
Ruedi stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.

whereabouts: After dinner, Ruedi went up to the atelier.
In the atelier after dinner, Ruedi worked beside the master at his bench.
While the hall clock struck ten and the regulator showed 9:48, Ruedi was in the atelier working beside the master.
After the regulator showed 10:20, the master sent Ruedi downstairs, and she went straight to the kitchen.
When the piano began, Ruedi was in the kitchen with Rosa.
Ruedi stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
That afternoon, the master was in the kitchen with Rosa's American alarm clock in his hands.
